Summary

This change revives `MONDO:0014978` from an obsolete PREMBL2 term into an active disease term with the requested modern label: `PADI6-related oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 16 and maternal-effect disorder`.

Rationale

`OMIM:617234` was already present in MONDO, but only on the obsolete term `obsolete preimplantation embryonic lethality 2`. Rather than minting a duplicate MONDO identifier, I reused that existing identifier and updated it to the current disease framing.

The revised definition and synonym set were based on the issue request plus the cited literature:

- `PMID:27545678` documents PADI6-associated female infertility with early embryonic arrest.
- `PMID:29693651` broadens the phenotype to a maternal-effect disorder spectrum that can include miscarriages and hydatidiform moles.

Changes made

- [x] Un-obsoleted `MONDO:0014978`
- [x] Renamed it to `PADI6-related oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 16 and maternal-effect disorder`
- [x] Replaced the obsolete PREMBL2-only definition with a literature-backed disease definition
- [x] Restored `OMIM:617234` as an active `MONDO:equivalentTo` xref
- [x] Added `subset: omim {source="OMIM:617234"}`
- [x] Added exact/abbreviation synonyms for `oocyte/zygote/embryo maturation arrest 16`, `PREIMPLANTATION EMBRYONIC LETHALITY 2`, and `PREMBL2`
- [x] Kept the requested parent `MONDO:0014769` inherited oocyte maturation defect
- [x] Added gene-based logical and asserted axioms using `http://identifiers.org/hgnc/20449` for `PADI6`
- [x] Added provenance back to issue `#9855`
- [x] Removed obsolete-only metadata (`is_obsolete`, `consider`, `MONDO:excludePhenotype`)

Identifier and source checks

- Verified the parent term in `mondo-edit.obo` with `obo-grep.pl`
- Verified the existing MONDO/OMIM linkage for `OMIM:617234` in `mondo-edit.obo`
- Verified the PADI6 human gene identifier as `HGNC:20449` via the NCBI Gene record for human `PADI6`, which cites HGNC as the primary source

Validation performed

- [x] Checked the term back into `src/ontology/mondo-edit.obo`
- [x] Ran normalization with ODK: `make NORM` and replaced `mondo-edit.obo` with the normalized output
- [x] Ran syntax conversion validation with `robot convert --catalog catalog-v001.xml -i mondo-edit.obo -f obo -o mondo-edit.TMP.obo`

Local commit

- `8e08550` `Revive PADI6 maternal-effect disorder term`
